title: Chargaff's 1950 paper on the chemistry of nucleic acids
summary: Chargaff published on the base composition of nucleic acids before the double-helix paper.
body: Erwin Chargaff, "Chemical specificity of nucleic acids and mechanism of their enzymatic degradation" (Experientia, 1950), is a primary paper on base composition. The pairing rules A with T and G with C in the Watson-Crick model use regularities of the kind Chargaff reported. This card cites his paper and does not restate numerical base ratios that were not re-read from it.
